gb_platform_group.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `gb_platform_group` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '主键ID',
  `name` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '分组名称',
  `code` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '分组国标编码',
  `platform_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '上级平台主键',
  `parent_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '父分组主键',
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_platform_code` (`platform_id`,`code`),
  KEY `idx_platform_parent` (`platform_id`,`parent_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

gb_platform_share.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `gb_platform_share` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '主键ID',
  `platform_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '上级平台主键',
  `group_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '推送分组主键',
  `resource_id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '通道主键',
  `exposed_code` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '对上级暴露国标码',
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_platform_resource` (`platform_id`,`resource_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_platform_exposed_code` (`platform_id`,`exposed_code`),
  KEY `idx_platform_group` (`platform_id`,`group_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

gb_device_channel.ddl:
CREATE TABLE `gb_device_channel` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL COMMENT '主键ID',
  `device_id` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '所属设备国标ID',
  `channel_id` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '通道/分组国标码',
  `report_name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '上报原始名称',
  `name` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '自定义显示名称',
  `manufacturer` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '厂商',
  `model` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '型号',
  `owner` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '设备归属',
  `civil_code` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '行政区划编码',
  `block` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '警区',
  `address` varchar(500) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '安装地址',
  `parental` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '0通道 1分组',
  `safety_way` tinyint DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '信令安全模式',
  `register_way` tinyint DEFAULT '1' COMMENT '注册方式',
  `cert_num` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '证书序列号',
  `certifiable` tinyint DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '证书有效标识',
  `err_code` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '证书无效原因码',
  `end_time` datetime DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '证书终止有效期',
  `secrecy` tinyint DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '保密属性',
  `ip_address` varchar(64) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '通道IP',
  `port` int DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '通道端口',
  `password` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '通道密码',
  `status` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT 'OFF' COMMENT '在线状态 ON/OFF/UNREGISTERED',
  `longitude` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '经度',
  `latitude` double DEFAULT NULL COMMENT '纬度',
  `ptz_type` tinyint DEFAULT '0' COMMENT '云台类型 0未知 1球机 2半球 3枪机 4遥控枪机',
  `parent_id` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL COMMENT '父节点国标码',
  `source` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '3' COMMENT '数据来源 1新增 2导入 3注册',
  `create_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '创建时间',
  `update_time` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP COMMENT '更新时间',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_device_channel` (`device_id`,`channel_id`),
  KEY `idx_channel_id` (`channel_id`),
  KEY `idx_parent_id` (`parent_id`),
  KEY `idx_status` (`status`),
  KEY `idx_source` (`source`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
